name: Perhaps It Will Take Me Home
source:
You're stranded somewhere in the countryside. You don't know how you got here, but you need to find your way back.

[From [url=https://inquisitiveturtlestudios.itch.io/perhapsitwilltakemehome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你受困于某处偏僻乡间。你不知道自己为何会流落至此，但你必须找到回去的路。

[摘自[url=https://inquisitiveturtlestudios.itch.io/perhapsitwilltakemehome]itch.io[/url]]
